assessment_summary.project_name: Front mount bracket FEA rev B
assessment_summary.cou_name: Quasi-static structural response of battery pack front mount bracket under 10 g longitudinal and combined service loads to support EVT release and bolt class selection

evidence_keywords: Refinement study: Three meshes (M1/M2/M3). Peak von Mises at the inner fillet: 257 MPa (M1, 2.0 mm), 246 MPa (M2, 1.5 mm), 242 MPa (M3, 1.0 mm).
Change M2→M3 = −1.6%.
Displacement at the load reference: 0.66 mm, 0.63 mm, 0.62 mm respectively.
Element edge size ~6 mm bulk; 2.0 mm at fillets; 1.2 mm along hole chamfers.
Convergence tolerances default (residual 1e-3).
Automatic time incrementation, initial 0.05, min 1e-6, max 0.2.
Contact chattering suppressed after switching to augmented Lagrange; no artificial overclosure observed.
Chassis interface plate modeled as rigid to isolate bracket behavior; compliance of the chassis rails is not included in this phase.
Plastic: true stress–strain from in-house tensile coupons (lot L3207), fitted to a bilinear curve
Nonlinear contact and elastoplastic material enabled.
Alternate constraint: Replaced rigid chassis plate with a 3 mm shell patch tied to the bracket footprint
true stress–strain from in-house tensile coupons (lot L3207)
μ = 0.25 (phosphate/oil assumption)
initial preload 18 kN each
8.2 kN forward and 1.3 kN vertical (worst-case combined per RM-17)
Friction: μ varied 0.20–0.35.
Preload: 15–22 kN per bolt.

expected_factors.factor_type: Relevance of the quantities of interest
evidence_keywords: Decision tie-in: Go/no-go for EVT bracket release and bolt class selection.
Max von Mises in bracket: 242 MPa at inner fillet toe (M3).
Bolt utilization: Bolt axial under combined load: 23–31% of proof after preload.
Deflection at the saddle 0.62 mm in the load direction

expected_factors.factor_type: Relevance of the validation activities to the COU

name_keywords: Hand estimate: Treat the inner lobe as a curved beam

expected_decision.outcome_source: Proceed with EVT using class 10.9 hardware and target bolt preload ≥18 kN.
rationale_keywords: Bolt axial under combined load: 23–31% of proof
